results.name: setop distinct outer order limit offset
results.walrusSql: SELECT amount AS v FROM orders WHERE amount <= 25 UNION SELECT amount AS x FROM orders WHERE amount >= 25 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1
results.sqliteSql: SELECT amount AS v FROM orders WHERE amount <= 25 UNION SELECT amount AS x FROM orders WHERE amount >= 25 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1

results.name: setop all outer order limit offset
results.walrusSql: SELECT amount AS v FROM orders WHERE amount <= 25 UNION ALL SELECT amount AS x FROM orders WHERE amount >= 25 ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 4 OFFSET 1
results.sqliteSql: SELECT amount AS v FROM orders WHERE amount <= 25 UNION ALL SELECT amount AS x FROM orders WHERE amount >= 25 ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 4 OFFSET 1

results.name: setop window combo derived
results.walrusSql: SELECT uid, amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY amt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT user_id AS uid, amount AS amt FROM orders WHERE user_id IN ('u1','u4') UNION ALL SELECT user_id AS uid, amount AS amt FROM orders WHERE id='o1') u ORDER BY uid, rn
results.sqliteSql: SELECT uid, amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY amt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT user_id AS uid, amount AS amt FROM orders WHERE user_id IN ('u1','u4') UNION ALL SELECT user_id AS uid, amount AS amt FROM orders WHERE id='o1') u ORDER BY uid, rn
